areas.t: Monday, a ridge of high pressure aloft will reduce atmospheric mixing. However, periods of moderate southeasterly winds will aid dispersion, while mostly cloudy skies hinder ozone development. As a result, AQI levels will be Good to high-Good.  Tuesday, as a cold front approaches Louisiana, moderate
